i.norm: Verifies that {@code Entities.unescape} leaves a URL with ampersand-delimited query parameters unchanged. Without this guard, substrings like {@code &int} (a valid HTML entity for ∫) or {@code &num_rooms} could be misread as entity references and replaced with their Unicode equivalents, corrupting the URL.
URL whose query string contains segments that resemble HTML entity names (e.g. "&int=" looks like the integral-sign entity, "&num_rooms=" starts with "&num")
